title: Organization Registration & Onboarding
i_want_to: Create an organization account and complete onboarding
so_that: I can start managing events under my organization
acceptance_criteria: User can sign up with email/password or social login (Google, Facebook)
Organization name and subdomain are validated for uniqueness
Welcome email is sent with getting started guide
Default Free tier is assigned automatically
Onboarding checklist shows next steps

title: Create New Event
i_want_to: Create a new event by selecting type and filling details
so_that: I can start planning and inviting guests
acceptance_criteria: User can select from 6 event types (Wedding, Birthday, Conference, Meetup, Commemoration, Custom)
Event form includes: name, date, time, timezone, venue, description
Theme is automatically suggested based on event type
Event can be saved as draft or published immediately
Unique event URL is generated upon creation

title: Dynamic Theme Application
i_want_to: Apply and customize themes for my event
so_that: My event has a cohesive visual identity
acceptance_criteria: Themes load dynamically based on event type selection
User can preview theme before applying
Custom colors, fonts, and logos can be uploaded
Theme changes reflect in real-time across web and mobile
Fallback to default theme if custom theme fails to load

title: Bulk Guest Import
i_want_to: Import guests from CSV, Excel, or Google Contacts
so_that: I can quickly build my guest list without manual entry
acceptance_criteria: CSV/Excel template is provided for download
File upload supports up to 10,000 guests in single import
Duplicate detection warns about existing guests
Import preview shows validation errors before confirmation
Progress bar displays import status for large files

title: Manual Guest Management
i_want_to: Add, edit, and delete individual guests
so_that: I can manage my guest list with precision
acceptance_criteria: Add guest form includes: name, email, phone, role, table number, dietary preferences
Guest list is searchable and filterable by role, RSVP status, table
Guests can be assigned to roles (VIP, Regular, Staff, Speaker, etc.)
Plus-ones can be added per guest
Delete action requires confirmation and archives guest data

title: QR Code Generation for Guests
i_want_to: Generate unique QR codes for each guest
so_that: Guests can be checked in quickly at the event
acceptance_criteria: QR code is generated automatically when guest is added
QR codes contain encrypted guest ID and event ID
Batch download of all QR codes as PDF is available
Individual QR codes can be emailed to guests
QR codes are printable in multiple sizes

title: Send Event Invitations
i_want_to: Send invitations via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
so_that: Guests receive event details and can RSVP
acceptance_criteria: Invitation templates are provided per event type
Custom message can be added to invitations
Recipients can be selected individually or by group
Invite includes event details, QR code, and RSVP link
Delivery status is tracked (sent, delivered, opened)

title: Guest RSVP Submission
i_want_to: Submit my RSVP response online
so_that: The organizer knows if I'm attending
acceptance_criteria: RSVP form is accessible via unique link or QR code
Form includes: attendance status, plus-ones, dietary preferences, notes
Form is mobile-responsive and loads in < 2 seconds
Confirmation page shows after submission
Confirmation email is sent to guest

title: RSVP Tracking Dashboard
i_want_to: View real-time RSVP responses
so_that: I can track attendance and plan accordingly
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows: total invited, responded, attending, declining, pending
RSVP rate percentage is calculated and displayed
Responses can be filtered by date, role, table
Export RSVP data to CSV is available
Real-time updates when new responses arrive

title: Automated RSVP Reminders
i_want_to: Send automated reminders to non-responders
so_that: I can increase RSVP completion rates
acceptance_criteria: Reminder schedule can be configured (e.g., 7 days before event)
Reminders can be sent via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
Non-responders are automatically identified
Reminder templates are customizable
Reminder history is logged

title: Waitlist Management
i_want_to: Manage a waitlist for capacity-limited events
so_that: I can fill spots when guests cancel
acceptance_criteria: Waitlist can be enabled with maximum capacity setting
Guests can join waitlist when event is full
Automatic promotion when spot becomes available
Promoted guest receives notification with deadline to confirm
Waitlist position is visible to waitlisted guests

title: Mobile QR Check-in
i_want_to: Scan guest QR codes using mobile app
so_that: Guests can be checked in quickly
acceptance_criteria: Camera scanner activates within 1 second
Valid QR codes show guest details and check-in confirmation
Invalid/expired QR codes show error message
Offline mode caches scans and syncs when online
Check-in timestamp and device ID are recorded

title: Check-in Analytics
i_want_to: View real-time check-in statistics
so_that: I can monitor event attendance flow
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows: total checked in, remaining, no-shows
Check-in rate per hour is graphed
Heatmap shows peak check-in times
Average check-in time per guest is calculated
Data exports to CSV/PDF

title: Event Chat Rooms
i_want_to: Participate in event chat rooms
so_that: I can connect with other attendees
acceptance_criteria: Global chat room is available to all guests
Table-based chat rooms auto-assign based on seating
Private messaging between guests is supported
Messages support text, images, and emojis
Chat history persists for event duration

title: Photo Gallery Upload
i_want_to: Upload photos to the event gallery
so_that: I can share memories with other guests
acceptance_criteria: Photos can be uploaded from mobile or web
Multiple photos can be selected at once
Upload progress is shown with estimated time
Photos are compressed and optimized for web
Guest can add captions to photos

title: Photo Moderation
i_want_to: Review and approve photos before publishing
so_that: Inappropriate content is filtered out
acceptance_criteria: Pending photos queue shows unapproved uploads
Organizer can approve or reject with reason
AI auto-tags people and objects in photos
Approved photos appear in public gallery
Rejected photos are archived and not visible

title: Ticket Sales & Payment
i_want_to: Sell tickets and collect payments
so_that: I can monetize my event
acceptance_criteria: Ticket tiers can be created (General, VIP, Early Bird)
Prices are set per tier with currency support
Stripe integration processes payments securely
Payment confirmation email is sent to buyer
Refunds can be issued partially or fully

title: Subscription Tier Upgrade
i_want_to: Upgrade my organization subscription tier
so_that: I can access more features and higher limits
acceptance_criteria: Pricing page shows all tiers and features
Upgrade is processed via Stripe Checkout
New features unlock immediately after payment
Prorated billing is applied for mid-cycle upgrades
Invoice is emailed to organization admin

title: Analytics Dashboard Overview
i_want_to: View comprehensive event analytics
so_that: I can measure event success and ROI
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows: RSVP rate, check-in rate, engagement score
Guest demographics breakdown (role, location, response time)
Revenue vs. costs summary
Timeline view of key metrics over event lifecycle
Comparative analytics across multiple events

title: Multi-Language Support
i_want_to: View event content in my preferred language
so_that: I can understand event details easily
acceptance_criteria: Language selector is available on all guest-facing pages
Supported languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Arabic
RSVP forms, invitations, and notifications translate automatically
Organizer can provide custom translations for event-specific content
Browser language is detected and applied by default

title: Seating Chart Designer
i_want_to: Create and manage seating arrangements
so_that: Guests know where to sit at the event
acceptance_criteria: Visual drag-and-drop table designer
Tables can be named and sized
Guests can be assigned to tables individually or in bulk
Seating chart can be printed or shared digitally
Conflicts (e.g., dietary needs) are highlighted

title: Push Notifications
i_want_to: Receive push notifications about event updates
so_that: I stay informed about important changes
acceptance_criteria: Mobile app requests notification permission on first launch
Notifications for: event reminders, schedule changes, announcements
Notification preferences can be customized per guest
Notifications work in background and when app is closed
Notification history is accessible in-app

title: Event Announcement Broadcasting
i_want_to: Send announcements to all guests
so_that: Everyone receives important updates
acceptance_criteria: Announcement composer supports text, images, and links
Broadcast reaches all guests via push, email, and in-app
Delivery status is tracked per channel
Urgent announcements bypass quiet hours
Announcement archive is maintained

title: Team Collaboration & Roles
i_want_to: Invite team members with specific permissions
so_that: We can collaborate on event planning
acceptance_criteria: Team members can be invited via email
Roles: Admin, Editor, Viewer, Check-in Staff
Permissions are granular per feature module
Team activity log tracks all actions
Team members can be removed or have roles changed

title: Recurring Events
i_want_to: Create recurring event series
so_that: I don't have to recreate similar events
acceptance_criteria: Recurrence patterns: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, custom
Guest list can be copied from previous event
Settings and theme are inherited from template
Each occurrence has unique URL and QR codes
Series can be cancelled or edited individually
